forensic_gaps_found.title: Inverted Run-Up Formula Turning Falling Knives into Bullish Buys
forensic_gaps_found.historical_impact: Legacy BULLISH swing trades had a 20.69% Win Rate (6W / 23L) and -50.93% cumulative PnL. 24 of 29 BULLISH trades had NO news catalyst ('Technical Baseline').
forensic_gaps_found.root_cause_in_code: score_runup = np.clip(100.0 - (runup_5d * 10.0), -50.0, 50.0) gave maximum +50.0 (+17.5 weighted pts) whenever 5D return was <= +5%, including crashing stocks (runup_5d < 0%) with weak volume.
forensic_gaps_found.fix_applied_in_v5_1: Replaced with compute_bimodal_catalyst_score() in ticker_utils.py: BULLISH momentum requires constructive 5D trend (-1.5% to +6.5%), RSI >= 45, and a real positive catalyst (score >= 20) OR deeply oversold RSI < 32 reversal.

forensic_gaps_found.title: Ultra-Tight Static Stops (-2.5% / -3.5%) & Day-1 Opening Wick Whipsaws
forensic_gaps_found.historical_impact: 50 of 99 losses (50.51%) stopped out in <= 2 trading days (28 on Day 1). Post-exit price forensics prove 30.0% (15/50) of those early stop-outs subsequently moved >= +2% in the predicted direction and 20.0% (10/50) hit the full profit target (e.g., COLPAL +10.58%, TRENT +8.29%, INFY +8.19%, ICICIPRULI +7.52%). Additionally, 180D Contrarian Moats (SIEMENS, ABB) were prematurely stopped out at -8.0% on Day 12-14.
forensic_gaps_found.root_cause_in_code: Hardcoded -2.5% (Bullish) and +3.5% (Bearish) stops are smaller than normal 1-day NSE F&O High-Low noise (2.2%-3.8% ATR). Furthermore, checking intraday High/Low on Day 1 triggered stops on opening gap wicks before mean-reversion began.
forensic_gaps_found.fix_applied_in_v5_1: Implemented compute_dynamic_atr_brackets() (2.2x ATR14 stop, floor 3.2% / 4.0%, 1.75:1 R:R target; -15.0% structural stop for 180D Contrarian Moats) AND Day-1 Close-Only Stop Protection in evaluate_trade_lifecycle().

forensic_gaps_found.title: Zero Cooldown & Repeatedly Shorting Secular Momentum Leaders
forensic_gaps_found.historical_impact: 68 of 192 trades (35.42%) were repeat entries on the same ticker within <= 5 days. Just 5 strong uptrending stocks (TRENT 1W/6L, HCLTECH 1W/5L, TORNTPOWER 0W/4L, ICICIGI 0W/4L, BHARTIARTL 0W/4L) generated 2W / 23L (8.0% WR, -76.06% PnL). All other 109 BEARISH_FADE trades achieved a 55.05% Win Rate (60W / 49L) and +88.27% cumulative PnL!
forensic_gaps_found.root_cause_in_code: No check prevented audit_daemon.py or catalyst_app.py from opening a new paper trade on a ticker that already had an OPEN position or had repeatedly stopped out on BEARISH_FADE.
forensic_gaps_found.fix_applied_in_v5_1: Added is_ticker_in_cooldown_or_blacklisted() enforcing a 5-day cooldown, blocking duplicate OPEN tickers, and blocking BEARISH_FADE shorts on tickers with >=2 prior short stop-outs and <25% short win rate or strong positive 20D trend.

forensic_gaps_found.title: Unbounded Substring Regex ('eir', 'vai') Matching Non-Pharma Tickers as USFDA Events
forensic_gaps_found.historical_impact: Non-pharma stocks (TITAN, ITC, WIPRO, TCS, HDFCLIFE, TORNTPOWER) matched 'USFDA / Regulatory Action (-85)' and went 1W / 5L (16.67% WR).
forensic_gaps_found.root_cause_in_code: Plain substring matching for 'eir' (Establishment Inspection Report) and 'vai' (Voluntary Action Indicated) matched common English words like 'their' and 'available' across all sectors.
forensic_gaps_found.fix_applied_in_v5_1: Added word-boundary regex (\busfda\b, \boai\b, \beir\b) AND gated USFDA regulatory patterns strictly behind is_pharma_healthcare_ticker(sym).

forensic_gaps_found.title: Uncalibrated Static Confidence ('High' / '75%') & Daemon Schema Mismatch
forensic_gaps_found.historical_impact: 165 closed trades had static '75%' confidence with only 42.42% realized accuracy; daemon omitted Market_Regime and Catalyst_Score columns, causing '?? Sideways / Rangebound' encoding artifacts.
forensic_gaps_found.root_cause_in_code: audit_daemon.py hardcoded Confidence = 'High' and 12 columns instead of 14; catalyst_app.py overwrote 'High' with '75%'.
forensic_gaps_found.fix_applied_in_v5_1: Synchronized 14-column schema across audit_daemon.py and catalyst_app.py, calibrated empirical probability via calibrate_empirical_probability(), and cleaned encoding artifacts.
